data.name: Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop
data.detailed_description:
Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop — Brew, Explore, Fight, and Build Your Magical Trade!

Step into a world of magic, danger, and opportunity in Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop. Build your own workshop, craft powerful potions, explore lands filled with rare ingredients, grow your own magical crops, and turn a humble alchemist’s bench into a thriving business. Take on deadly threats with melee weapons, ranged combat, and arcane powers as you forge your name as a true master of the craft.

Craft Potions and Master the Art of Alchemy

Crafting is at the heart of your journey. Gather rare herbs, crystals, mushrooms, monster parts, and mysterious essences to brew potions, elixirs, oils, and magical tools. Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, refine your process, and create products worthy of nobles, adventurers, and dangerous clients alike. Every mixture matters, and every creation can shape your reputation.


Explore a World Full of Secrets

The world beyond your workshop is filled with opportunity. Venture into forests, ruins, caves, swamps, and forgotten paths in search of rare ingredients, hidden treasures, and ancient knowledge. Exploration is not only about gathering resources — it is how you unlock stronger recipes, discover magical artifacts, and expand your understanding of the arcane.

Run Your Own Arcane Workshop

Your workshop is your livelihood. Set prices, manage stock, fulfill customer requests, upgrade your equipment, and expand your shop to serve more demanding clients. From common healing potions to rare magical creations, every item you place on your shelves can shape your profits and your reputation. Build an arcane business that reflects your style and ambition.

Grow Magical Ingredients

A true alchemist does not rely on merchants alone. Cultivate your own garden and grow valuable herbs, enchanted plants, fungi, and rare crops used in advanced brewing. Improve your farming setup, unlock new seeds, and keep a steady supply of ingredients ready for your next experiment. Smart farming means better potions, lower costs, and greater independence.



Fight with Steel, Arrows, and Magic

Not every ingredient can be bought, grown, or found safely. Face the dangers of the world with a full range of combat options. Use melee weapons for close encounters, ranged attacks for precision, and spells and magical powers to control the battlefield. Hunt dangerous creatures, survive hostile regions, and return with the rarest materials your workshop has ever seen.

Singleplayer and Co-op Support

Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop can be played alone or with friends in co-op. Work together to gather ingredients, manage the workshop, defend against threats, and grow your magical trade faster than ever. Split duties, combine strengths, and build the ultimate arcane business as a team.

Key Features

  • Deep Alchemy Crafting: Gather, combine, experiment, and discover powerful potions, magical items, and advanced recipes.

  • Exploration and Discovery: Travel through dangerous and mysterious regions to uncover rare resources, secrets, and ancient knowledge.

  • Shop Management: Run your own arcane workshop, manage inventory, fulfill requests, upgrade stations, and grow your business.

  • Magical Farming: Plant, harvest, and maintain your own supply of rare ingredients and enchanted crops.

  • Action Combat: Fight with melee weapons, ranged tools, spells, and magical abilities to survive and secure valuable loot.
    Solo or Co-op: Play alone or with friends and share the journey of becoming a legendary alchemist.

Why Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop?

Master Alchemist Simulator: Arcane Workshop brings together the satisfaction of crafting, the excitement of exploration, the strategy of shop management, the reward of farming, and the thrill of combat in one magical experience. Whether you want to perfect every recipe, build a prosperous business, or brave the wilds in search of rare ingredients, the path to mastery is yours to create.

Light the furnace, sharpen your blade, prepare your spells, and open the doors of your workshop — your journey to arcane mastery begins now.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 @ 3.30 GHz
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 780 GTX or AMD Radeon Radeon R7 260X series card or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 @ 3,2 GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
